summary: forshtat 提交 Commit-Reveal Transaction Frames（EIP-8209），在 frame 交易中加入提交揭示以处理包含时隐私。Giulio2002 提议把合约代码上限从 24KiB 提高到 64KiB。fradamt 在 ethresear.ch 提出解耦出块与最终性时间线，让 slot 更快而最终性不变慢。

items.title: 新增 EIP：把合约最大大小提高到 64KiB
items.note: （Giulio2002）提交：代码上限由 24KiB 升至 64KiB，initcode 由 48KiB 升至 128KiB，保留 EIP-3860 的 2:1 比例，INITCODE_WORD_COST 不变。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Increase Maximum Contract Size to 64KiB
items.note_en: (Giulio2002), submitted: code size from 24KiB to 64KiB and initcode from 48KiB to 128KiB, keeping EIP-3860's 2:1 ratio with INITCODE_WORD_COST unchanged.

items.title: ethresear.ch：用解耦共识加快最终性
items.note: （fradamt）02:56：当前每个 slot 有占验证者 1/32 的大委员会在关键路径上投票，缩小委员会能加快 slot 却会拖慢最终性，文章提出把两条时间线分开；ethresear.ch：延迟降低对质押收益的影响 03:09。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Unblocking faster finality with decoupled consensus
items.note_en: (fradamt), 02:56: today a committee of 1/32 of validators votes in the critical path each slot, and shrinking it speeds slots but slows finality, so the post separates the two timelines; ethresear.ch: Effects of Latency Reduction on Staking Revenue, 03:09.

summary_en: forshtat submitted Commit-Reveal Transaction Frames (EIP-8209), adding commit reveal to frame transactions to address inclusion time privacy. Giulio2002 proposed raising the contract code limit from 24KiB to 64KiB. fradamt proposed on ethresear.ch decoupling the block production and finality timelines so slots get faster without slowing finality.
